Question Choices: Fill: A line that divides a shape into two mirror-image halves is called a line of ________. (symmetry or rotation)
Hints: A symmetry line must reflect the entire shape exactly onto itself.
Solution: A line of symmetry divides the shape into two mirror-image halves that coincide exactly when folded along that line.

Question Choices: Select. Use ideal upright capital letters with uniform strokes and no serifs. O is an oval with no opening or tail; L has a left post and bottom arm; P has a left post and upper loop only; Q is an oval with a single diagonal tail at its lower right. Which letter has a horizontal line of symmetry? ~~L | O | P | Q~~
Hints: Reflect the whole letter across its horizontal centre line, including any tail.
Solution: The top and bottom halves of O match. L has no matching top arm; P has no matching bottom loop; Q has no matching upper-right tail. Only O has a horizontal line of symmetry.

Question Choices: Select. Use ideal upright capital letters with uniform strokes and no serifs. H has equal vertical posts joined at their midpoints; A has equal sloping sides and a centred crossbar; C is a circular arc with matching upper and lower ends and an opening on the right; R has a left post, an upper loop on the right and a diagonal lower-right leg. Which letter has more than one line of symmetry? ~~A | R | C | H~~
Hints: Count every reflection line that makes the whole letter match itself.
Solution: H has two reflection lines: vertical and horizontal. A has one vertical reflection line. C has one horizontal reflection line; its opening prevents a vertical match. R has none because its loop and leg do not match under reflection. Only H has more than one line.

Question Choices: Select the shape that has exactly four lines of symmetry: ~~Rectangle | Circle | Square | Triangle~~
Hints: Test vertical, horizontal and diagonal folds. A non-square rectangle has two; a square has four.
Solution: A square has two diagonal and two midpoint-to-midpoint reflection axes, four in total. A non-square rectangle has 2,a circle infinitely many,a triangle at most 3.

Question Choices: Fill: A regular pentagon (all sides and angles equal) has ________ lines of symmetry.
Hints: A regular polygon has the same number of symmetry lines as sides.
Solution: A regular 5-sided polygon has 5 reflection axes. Count each complete mirror line once, so the answer is 5.
